condAbloom_desc: When the equipper triggers <ct color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</ct>, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 48 for 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration.
condFreeze_desc: When the equipper triggers a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Freeze</ct> effect, their All-Attribute Anomaly DMG and <ct color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</ct> DMG increase by 16% for 30s; repeated triggers reset the duration.
